verdict.rationale: Docs confirm you can import/export at any time in Markdown or Any-Block format (anytype-docs-11, anytype-docs-20), which supports open-format portability. However hands-on community reports directly contradict the 'easy to leave' claim: one user notes 'I can't just use raw Markdown or CSV file with Anytype' unlike Obsidian, and another calls the import/export process 'painful' and 'Unusable for my own backup purposes' (anytype-comm-8, anytype-comm-13), plus another noting data isn't fully accessible externally (anytype-comm-6). Missing for 10: independent verification that exported Markdown/Any-Block preserves full fidelity, support for widely-open formats like CSV, and hands-on confirmation the export process is smooth rather than painful.
